descs: Six thorny roots burst from the ground in a star shape and root everything they cross.
Eight roots and a ray of sunlight that heals you for 20% while the spores put nearby enemies to sleep.
Ten roots, the sun and a giant flower that opens around you in three waves of petals.
A column of fire engulfs you and bursts into a ring that burns and leaves the ground ablaze.
Three rings of fire and six magma fissures that spit flames.
Fourteen fireballs rain down on the enemies and it all ends in an enormous explosion with magma cracks.
You spin inside your shell: a whirlpool drags in nearby enemies, hits them non-stop and ends in a wave.
A giant wave spreads out from you in a circle, drags everyone along and leaves rain.
A wave and two water cannons that sweep 360° around you.
You throw eight silk nets around you: they trap and damage anyone who steps on them for 4 s.
The cocoon hardens: 4 s of invulnerability, a 40% shield and repelling waves, with a burst at the end.
A cloud of butterflies and colorful scales puts to sleep, paralyzes and poisons over a huge area and ends in a gale.
Two rings of 24 stingers shoot out in every direction and poison.
The cocoon hardens with a 35% shield and a 6 m toxic cloud surrounds you for 4 s.
Eight ghost Beedrill fly with you for 4 s and dive down with their stingers.
A whirlwind advances 16 m toward your target, dragging along and hitting everything it finds.
Two tornadoes in a fan and a gust of wind that pushes back nearby enemies.
Three tornadoes and a flock of Pidgeot diving down on the enemies.
You jump from enemy to enemy biting 7 in a row, invulnerable while it lasts.
Twelve bites in a row; enemies left below 30% HP drop instantly (not bosses). It ends with a bite that cracks the ground.
A 20 m wind drill pierces everything in a straight line and cracks the ground.
The drill and five Fearow swooping down from the sky.
A spiral of poison pulls everyone toward you and squeezes them: damage, poison and root.
Arbok's eye paralyzes everyone within 20 m for 3 s; then three waves of mud and toxic geysers.
The sky charges up: for 2.4 s lightning rains non-stop on nearby enemies, and at the end three enormous thunderclaps.
You zigzag through the enemies wrapped in electricity and unleash an even longer storm.
You sink underground (invisible) and emerge with a tremor that stuns, four fissures and rock spikes.
Eight 16 m fissures run across the ground raising rock spikes, and a sandstorm breaks out.
You sow 14 toxic spikes around you that burst on contact, and gain a 20% shield.
A ring of toxic geysers protects you for 4 s and you gain a 30% shield.
A Body Press that cracks the ground and stuns, Earth Power geysers under 12 enemies and a 40% shield.
A 16 m charge with the poisoned horn pierces everything in front.
The charge ends in a drill that finishes off enemies below 25% HP (not bosses).
Three stomps: each one a bigger earthquake and three poisonous fissures ahead; the last one, a Megahorn.
An enormous moon appears above you: eight moonbeams fall on the enemies (charm) and you recover 20% HP.
The moon brings a rain of 16 stars and ends in an enormous lunar wave; you recover 30% of HP.
Nine will-o-wisps spin around you and each launches itself at an enemy: they burn and curse.
Nine fire tails sweep the ground in a star shape, eighteen will-o-wisps hunt for enemies and a millennial grudge curses and confuses everything within 15 m.
You sing a lullaby that puts everyone within 15 m to sleep for 2 s; then a final shout wakes the sleepers with a blow (+80% damage).
The lullaby puts everyone to sleep and you inflate like a balloon: three huge bounces crush the sleepers with ever-bigger waves.
Seven Zubat emerge from the darkness and bite non-stop for 3.5 s: they poison and every bite heals you.
A cloud of Golbat confuses with Supersonic and bites for 4 s; at the end you recover 25% HP.
A 12 m pollen cloud surrounds you for 2.5 s: it poisons, paralyzes or puts to sleep everything that breathes, at random.
A terrible 10 m stench accompanies you for 4 s: it poisons, confuses and pushes enemies away.
A giant flower opens at your feet, pollen rains on fourteen enemies and heals you for 15%.
Twelve mushrooms sprout around you and burst into spore clouds that put enemies to sleep and damage them.
Mushrooms sprout under sixteen enemies: the infected fall asleep and for 4 s the fungus drains their life for you.
Your compound eyes mark twelve enemies and you fire a Psybeam at each one: they get confused.
Six Venomoth surround you and shed scales that confuse and poison; it ends in an 18 m silver wind.
Ten Diglett pop up one after another under the enemies and launch them into the air (stun).
Three fissures advance toward your target, twenty Dugtrio pop up under the horde and the ground shakes three times.
Twenty gold coins rain down on the enemies: they hit, stun for an instant and leave ₽ on the ground.
The jewel on your forehead glows: six jewel beams spin around you and coins rain on the enemies.
You hold your head and three ever-bigger psychic waves burst, confusing.
The psychic waves and twelve water geysers that burst under the enemies, soak them and launch them into the air.
You jump from enemy to enemy throwing eight furious punches that stun, invulnerable while it lasts.
Twelve chained punches, a rain of rage fists and a final stomp that cracks the ground; the more damaged you are, the stronger it hits.
Six charges at extreme speed from enemy to enemy, leaving the ground in flames.
Ten flaming charges, columns of sacred fire on twelve enemies and a final ring of fire.
A giant spiral spins beneath your feet: it puts everyone within 13 m to sleep and ends in a wave.
The spiral turns into a whirlwind that drags in and hits for 2 s and puts the enemies it catches to sleep.
The whirlwind, three enormous Dynamic Punches on the strongest enemies (they confuse) and a final wave.
You teleport five times next to the enemies and a psychic wave bursts each time.
A giant spoon bends over you: everything within 15 m freezes for 1 s and is then slammed into the ground.
Two spoons, everything within 16 m freezes in place and sixteen Future Sight columns fall on the enemies.
Three bursts of karate chops sweep the front in a fan and push everyone back.
You jump very high and come down with all your weight: an enormous fissure stuns and launches everyone within 11 m.
Four arms strike in all four directions three times and it all ends in a Dynamic Punch that confuses.
Ten vine whips burst out in a star shape and lash everything they touch: they damage and root.
Whips and a rain of gastric acid on twelve enemies that leaves puddles: anyone who steps in them takes +25% damage.
A giant mouth appears in front, swallows every nearby enemy in one gulp and leaves a puddle of acid.
Ten tentacles burst from the ground beneath the enemies, lash them, poison them and trap them.
Sixteen tentacles, a poisonous tide that spreads out from you in a circle, and it starts to rain.
You curl up and roll 18 m toward your target, crushing and stunning everything you cross.
The roll, an avalanche of fourteen rocks on the enemies and six rocks rolling in all directions.
The roll and the avalanche end in an enormous explosion (without losing your Pokémon) that cracks the ground in a star shape.
You gallop in a circle leaving a 9 m ring of fire that burns and, when it closes, scorches everything inside.
The gallop, three fan-shaped fire trails and columns of sacred fire on the enemies.
A huge yawn puts everything within 14 m to sleep; shortly after, a psychic rain falls on ten sleepers (sleepers take ×1.8).
Your yawn and the Shellder on your tail bite eight enemies; it ends in a psychic geyser that confuses within 13 m.
A field of orbiting magnets pulls everyone within 12 m toward you and bursts in a discharge that paralyzes.
Several Magnemite accompany you and unleash lightning on the enemies while the magnetic field drags them in.
Three rings of spinning leeks burst out of you in all directions. With Maturity, leeks also rain from the sky and at the end a giant leek falls and cracks the ground.
You dash from enemy to enemy delivering nine double pecks, invulnerable while it lasts.
Three parallel 20 m charges devastate the front, then twelve triple pecks from enemy to enemy.
The ground is covered with ice within 13 m: enemies skate outward, gradually freeze and shards burst at the end.
Aurora beams fall on twelve enemies and freeze them, a frozen wave sweeps 15 m and it starts to hail.
A wave of mud spreads out from you in a circle up to 14 m, poisons everyone and leaves toxic puddles.
You melt into a giant 9 m puddle that pulls in, poisons and traps for 2 s, and bursts into mud geysers.
You shut yourself in your shell (30% shield) and when you open it you fire two rings of 20 pearls that freeze.
The shell, eighteen icicles falling from the sky on the enemies and a ring of ice spikes around you.
A 12 m cloud of poison gas engulfs you for 2.5 s: it curses (+25% damage taken) and poisons everything that breathes.
Fourteen shadow hands burst from the ground beneath the enemies, grab them (root) and curse them.
Six Gengar emerge from your shadow and leap at the enemies while Shadow Balls rain down; cursed enemies take double.
Onix rises from the ground in a circle around you, raising rocks and fissures that stun. With Maturity it goes around twice and rocks fall from the sky.
A giant pendulum swings over you: everything within 14 m falls asleep and then three psychic waves hit the sleepers (+80%).
The pendulum puts everyone within 16 m to sleep and you eat their dreams: each sleeper takes a huge hit and heals you (up to 30%).
Two giant pincers cut the ground in an X toward your target: 14 m fissures that stun, and a wave at the end.
The X-shaped fissures and a giant pincer fall on the three strongest enemies (stun) amid water geysers.
You roll from enemy to enemy eight times and every impact bursts into sparks that paralyze.
You charge up with electricity and explode without fainting: a 15 m explosion with eight electric fissures; with Maturity, Voltorb dive down and burst.
Fourteen eggs rain down on the enemies: when they break they release a psychic wave that confuses.
A giant palm tree grows above you, heals you for 15% and drops twelve giant eggs that stun; the leaves cut nearby enemies.
Eight bones spiral out up to 12 m and return to you, hitting on the way out and on the way back.
You smash the ground with a giant bone club: six fissures with ghost flames and a rain of dark bones that curse.
You jump from enemy to enemy with six kicks and finish with a High Jump Kick from the sky that cracks the ground. With Maturity, more kicks and a bigger crater.
Punches of fire, ice and lightning fall in turns on nine enemies (burning, freezing and paralyzing) and it ends with a giant Focus Punch from the sky. With Maturity, more hits.
Your tongue sweeps 360° around you (12 m): it pulls in and paralyzes everything it touches. With Maturity it sweeps twice and ends with a Heavy Slam that stuns.
A 9 m toxic cloud grows around you for 1.6 s, poisoning everyone, and then bursts in an enormous explosion.
Two clouds (yours and another in front), a gigantic detonation and eight chain explosions on the enemies.
You charge 18 m toward your target, trampling everything: it launches enemies into the air, stuns and leaves a trench of rocks.
The charge ends in a drill horn that pierces the ground and unleashes a rain of twelve rocks on the enemies.
Giant eggs fall on the enemies (6, 8 or 10 with Maturity): they burst, charm, and each one heals you for 4%. At the end, a wave of affection heals you for another 15%.
Your vines trap everyone within 13 m (more with Maturity), pull them toward you and squeeze them for 1.5 s; then the tangle bursts into leaves.
Mother and baby jump from enemy to enemy: a big punch and a small one on each (8, 10 or 12). It ends with a Mega Punch that cracks the ground.
You spit a 12 m cloud of ink that blinds everyone (charm) and fire twelve ink balls in all directions.
The ink, two whirlpools advancing toward your target and a dragon water jet falling from the sky on the strongest enemy.
Six Goldeen leap out of the water and pounce on the enemies for 3 s while waterfalls crash on eight of them.
Three horn charges in three directions, followed by six Seaking diving down and waterfalls on ten enemies.
You launch yourself spinning like a star that bounces from enemy to enemy ten times, faster each time.
The star bounces fourteen times and your core fires a beam of light that sweeps 360° around you.
You raise invisible walls in a circle: they trap everyone inside, immobilize them and burst into crystals that confuse. With Maturity the box is bigger and ends in a mist explosion that charms.
You cut through the horde in one slash after another (8, 11 or 14), leaving cuts in the air; half a second later all the cuts burst at once.

You dance an icy waltz: you blow kisses at twelve enemies that charm and freeze them, and a circling blizzard leaves them frozen. With Maturity, more kisses and ice crystals sprouting from the ground.
You jump from enemy to enemy throwing six thunder punches that paralyze, and finish with an enormous bolt on yourself. With Maturity, more punches and a final electric storm.
A volcano erupts beneath your feet: star-shaped magma fissures and a rain of fireballs on the enemies. With Maturity, more fissures and balls and a final eruption that wipes out everything.
Your pincers grab the three strongest enemies, lift them and slam them into the ground with a fissure that stuns. With Maturity you grab more and finish with an X-shaped guillotine.

A herd of five ghost Tauros gallops across the field toward your target: they trample, stun and launch everything they catch into the air. With Maturity the herd is bigger and comes back in a second crossing charge.
You jump three times with all your might: each landing raises an enormous wave, and at the end Magikarp rain from the sky.
Gyarados roars and charms everyone, two waterspouts advance toward your target and a Hyper Beam sweeps the front. With Maturity it starts to rain and a wave finishes it off.
You sing a lulling melody: the ground is covered with freezing ice and a huge wave full of icebergs sweeps everything around you. With Maturity the wave is bigger and ice columns sprout.
You transform and copy the Ultimate of a random League member, with your own strength.
A rain of Quick Attack stars falls on twelve enemies and ends in a charge that cracks the ground.
It depends on your evolution. Vaporeon: a tidal wave and Acid Armor (you heal 25%). Jolteon: electric pin missiles and a storm. Flareon: a fire star and blazes.
The world glitches: scan lines sweep 14 m, everything freezes for an instant and ten data cubes fall, bursting and cursing. With Maturity, more cubes and a data beam that sweeps 360°.
A spiral of fossil shells and rocks bursts out around you, traps whatever it touches and ends in a geyser.
The spiral, Omastar's tentacles drag in the horde and sixteen shell spikes rain from the sky.
You spin inside your shell for 1.6 s surrounded by four blades that strike non-stop, and finish with a splash.
You jump from enemy to enemy with six slashes and two X-shaped fissures cut the ground around you.
You soar high and dive down with a wave of ancient rocks; with Maturity, three dives and a flock of Aerodactyl.
You yawn (putting nearby enemies to sleep), jump and come down with all your weight: an earthquake that cracks the ground. With Maturity, two slams, fissures and Rest (you heal 30%).
A 3 s blizzard covers the map: icicles fall on the enemies, everything within 18 m gradually freezes and finally freezes solid; it starts to hail. With Maturity, three Articuno sweep the field.
Zapdos unleashes a 3 s storm: lightning strikes non-stop and five enormous thunderclaps hit the strongest. With Maturity, three Zapdos dive down and it rains.
Moltres spreads its wings: sixteen fireballs rain down, the earth cracks into magma and you are reborn with 30% HP. With Maturity, three Moltres dive down.
A cyclone of draconic flame advances 16 m toward your target, dragging along and hitting.
Dragonair's orbs: three dragon rings burst out of you, the weather changes to rain and two cyclones sweep the front.
Dragonite calls down the comets: twelve Draco Meteors fall from the sky, three Dragonite swoop down and a hurricane finishes it off.

Everything within 22 m stops for 1.2 s, marked by your mind; then psychic columns crush sixteen enemies and a mental wave bursts. With Maturity, Psystrike orbs chase the strongest and a barrier protects you.
A psychic bubble protects you (30% shield) and Mew copies the Ultimate of another random League member; with Maturity, two and then three in a row.
